children: CANBERA (dpa-AFX) - Sentiment in global markets remains cautious ahead of the release of consumer price inflation readings from the U.S. on Wednesday morning. The renewed increase in oil prices as well as geopolitical uncertainties weighed on markets.

Wall Street Futures are trading in mildly positive territory as markets await the key economic data releases. Major benchmarks in Europe are trading in the green. Earlier in the day, Asian markets had finished trading on a mostly negative note.
The six-currency Dollar Index has edged up. Bond yields mostly eased.
Oil resumed its climb amidst Hormuz strikes and Houthi attacks. Gold has declined more than a quarter percent. Cryptocurrencies are trading in positive territory.
Here is a snapshot of the major world markets at this hour.
Hong Kong's Hang Seng at 24,314.17, down 0.13%
Crude Oil WTI Futures (Nov) at $95.73, up 1.69%
